title: Larval Development
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rqzd5x6

steps.title: Collect Eggs
steps.instruction: Place flies from each of the 4 mitotypes into individual egg collection containers and collect eggs manually.

steps.title: Seed Eggs into Diet
steps.instruction: Add collected eggs to either the 1:2 or 1:16 P:C diet.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 6 bottles per mitotype per diet

steps.title: Add Microbiome and Monitor Eclosion
steps.instruction: Introduce the microbiome and monitor for fly eclosion.

substeps.instruction: Collect and count flies that eclose within a 3-day window

steps.title: Calculate Eclosion Percentage
steps.instruction: Determine the % eclosion by dividing the number of eclosed flies from each mitotype by the sum of both mitotypes.
